decisions.headline: 《明日方舟：终末地》新版本上线，“大願”进入本周武器兑换
decisions.summary: Hypergryph与GRYPHLINE于11月25日上线新版本“キノコ菌グ！？君との大冒険！”；AUTOMATON报道，管理人主题武器“大願”已进入“今週の武器”兑换阵容，兑换截至日本时间12月2日13时。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON正文；报道明确给出运营方、新版本上线、“大願”进入本周兑换阵容及截止时间。该条保持单一媒体报道边界，不把玩家讨论扩写为官方公告。
decisions.reason: 主体、窗口与核心更新事实清楚，属于可核实的服务内容更新。
decisions.timeNote: 所选来源发布时间2026-11-25T12:37:54Z折算为北京时间2026-11-25 20:37，位于固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《侠盗猎车手VI》动画总监称每种道具交互制作了3套动作
decisions.summary: IGN报道称，玩法动画总监Mike Jones透露，Rockstar为每种道具交互分别制作单手、双手和无需持握三套动作，以适配角色可同时拿取不同物品的新系统。
decisions.verification: 已打开IGN Games正文；报道明确转述玩法动画总监Mike Jones对制作规模的披露，并列出单手、双手与无需持握三类动作。事实边界限于该媒体转述。
decisions.reason: 具名开发负责人首次披露具体制作细节，主体、窗口和核心事实完整，符合feature信息增量。

entries.headline: Arknights: Endfield adds Daigan to the weekly weapon exchange
entries.summary: Hypergryph and GRYPHLINE released a new version on November 25. AUTOMATON reports that the Administrator-themed weapon Daigan has joined the weekly weapon exchange lineup until 1:00 p.m. JST on December 2.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the operators, version release, weekly exchange addition, and deadline; this remains a single-media report.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 20:37 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI animation director says each item interaction uses three animation sets
entries.summary: IGN reports that gameplay animation director Mike Jones said Rockstar created single-handed, two-handed, and hands-free animation sets for each item interaction, supporting the system that lets characters carry different objects at the same time.
entries.verification: The opened IGN Games report directly relays the named animation director's production-detail disclosure; the fact boundary remains limited to that relay.
